open_work: The retained 0.8 by 0.6 metre case plan and 1.94m top stay. Four floor-seated feet carry its original 0.22m base. Two actual shelves support the original alternating bottle seats at 0.66/1.04m.

The original projecting 60mm glass slab becomes one 6mm pane centred at Yn -45.202m, 28mm inward; fixed frame and passive hardware remain inside the original case plan and clear the adjacent notched bench by at least 10mm.

Six original red/teal bodies and corresponding rib identities become narrow hollow coloured glass bodies, twelve physical tactile ribs each, separate wood stoppers and blank fine-porcelain plates. Existing milk_glass charts and bounded local opaque tints replace visible lacquer/book atlases; every hidden original pose remains.

The closed leaf, hinge and lock plate are passive fabrication. Cupboard access, poison custody, dispensing and medical operations require their explicit gameplay owners. Carboys/fountain, independent services and continuous routes remain separate work.

The cupboard rear edge ends 60mm before its original maximum Y to clear the back-door knob. The glazed front, all six bottles, their centres/heights and shelf seats remain fixed. No access or poison-custody authority changes.
